title: Scrape title surgery & token preservation — scratchpad
content:
Context / intent:
This is a working notebook for heuristics I keep reusing when cleaning scraped product titles and preserving tokens that matter for downstream models. Goal is: remove noise (bad HTML, duplicated vendor tags, price stamps) while keeping brand/product/subattributes intact and minimizing accidental token splits that hurt embedding similarity or entity extraction.

Quick heuristics (high-level):
- Prefer token preservation over aggressive normalization unless the token is pure noise. If in doubt, tag as AMBIG or leave as is.
- Treat parentheses/brackets as attribute containers (SIZE, PACK, COLOR) unless they contain marketing copy ("New!", "Limited").
- Hyphens: keep when joining alpha tokens ("Ultra-Blend" => keep) but break when they join numeric and unit tokens ("20-oz" => normalize to "20 oz").
- Newline breaks in scraped titles: if broken mid-word ("micro-\nfilter"), join without inserting spaces; if broken between tokens, replace with single space.

Labeler decision flow (quick):
1) Strip obvious HTML tags and invisible characters (\u200B, \u00A0).
2) Collapse repeated vendor prefixes: leading patterns like "Sold by ACME | ACME" -> keep single brand token.
3) Detect size/units via regex: pattern '\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s?(?:oz|ml|g|kg|l|ct|count|pack|pk)'. Mark as SIZE or PACK_QUANTITY.
4) Detect promo/noise tokens: keywords ("new", "sale", "clearance", "% off", "free shipping") -> mark as PROMO_TAG or drop depending on target schema.
5) If title contains multiple parenthetical groups, map the first to PACK/SIZE and additional to ATTRIBUTES unless explicit.

Examples and edge cases: (labels in braces are suggestions for annotation)
- Raw: "Acme - Ultra-Blend 12oz (Pack of 2) — New!"
  Annotated: [Acme]{BRAND} [ - ]{DELIM} [Ultra-Blend]{PRODUCT_NAME} [12oz]{SIZE} [(Pack of 2)]{PACK_QUANTITY} [— New!]{PROMO_TAG}

- Raw: "SeaSalt\nCo. Organic Flakes 8oz" (newline mid-token)
  Rule: join mid-token => "SeaSaltCo. Organic Flakes 8oz" then split on punctuation -> [SeaSalt Co.]{BRAND} [Organic Flakes]{PRODUCT_NAME} [8oz]{SIZE}

- Raw: "Tetra Pak 200ml/6.8fl oz (Multipack - 3x)"
  Notes: keep both units, standardize numeric spacing: [Tetra Pak]{BRAND} [200ml / 6.8 fl oz]{SIZE} [(Multipack - 3x)]{PACK_QUANTITY}

- Raw: "ACME® SuperWidget 3000 - 32oz - discontinued"
  Decision: preserve model token "3000" as PRODUCT_MODEL, keep SIZE, mark trailing "discontinued" as LEGACY_FLAG or DROP depending on use-case.

- Raw: "13\" LED TV (refurb)" -> ambiguous quotes and inches: detect escaped quote marks, map 13\" to SIZE (inches).

Pattern suggestions (for pipeline):
- unit_pattern: "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s?(?:oz|ml|g|kg|l|fl oz|in|inch,\")"
- pack_pattern: "(?i)\\b(pack|pk|multipack|bundle|set)\\b.*\\d+"
- promo_pattern: "(?i)\\b(new|sale|clearance|refurb|open box|limited)\\b"

Labeler guidelines (short):
- If a token is partially numeric and alphabetic ("X100-Pro"), consider PRODUCT_MODEL: keep hyphen if both sides are alnum but separate if second side is unit ("100-oz" -> "100 oz").
- Preserve registered/trademark symbols as metadata but strip for token matching (store in raw_meta).
- When annotators disagree on whether parenthetical text is PACK vs ATTR, default to PACK for quantities, ATTR otherwise and flag sample for review.
- Use abstain tag when >25% of tokens are ambiguous or title appears templated (e.g., scraped shopping cart crumbs).

Open questions / TODOs:
- How aggressive should we be with brand deduping across tokens when brand name appears in model names? (JIRA: DATA-2147)
- Do we want to canonicalize units to metric/imperial pairs always, or only when both are present?
- Add small perturbation tests for downstream embed similarity: join vs split hyphen scenarios -> measure embedding drift.

Implementation notes for engineer pairing:
- Pipeline step ordering: strip HTML -> normalize invisible chars -> collapse repeated vendor prefix -> newline fixes -> hyphen handling -> regex unit/pack extraction -> final trimming.
- Keep a "recovery" field containing original raw title for audit and rollback.
- Log samples where a normalization reduces token overlap with product catalog by >40% for manual review.

Quick checklist for labelers (copyable):
- [ ] Remove visible HTML and weird unicode
- [ ] Fix mid-token linebreaks
- [ ] Detect and tag size/pack units
- [ ] Preserve model numbers and hyphenated alpha tokens
- [ ] Flag ambiguous parentheticals for review

Notes-to-self: may extract a 200-sample audit set to test these heuristics against current labeled corpus; aim to run A/B emb-sim test in the next sprint. Also ping @dataops for a small rule-to-jira automation to track fixes.

End of scratchpad.
